# Andrea Onori

> Photographer & Filmmaker based in Milan, Italy. Fashion, editorial and campaign imagery — stills and motion for brands and magazines.

It began in the Marche, where I was born. Today I'm based in Milan and work internationally as an independent filmmaker, mostly in fashion, advertising and media. I follow each project from the first idea to the final cut, treating every story as a film of its own.

Emotions rarely arrive with a shape: my craft is building the frame they need to find their meaning.
